What we do

Our missions

Three programmes, two field activities and four areas of help — all offered free of charge.

  1. 01

    Relief for people in need

    Food, clothing, financial and spiritual help for people going through hard times.

  2. 02

    Training workshops

    Workshops, seminars, talks and awareness campaigns that help people become self-reliant.

  3. 03

    Supporting other charities

    Backing the projects of other organizations working on social and humanitarian causes.

On the ground

Our activities

Food drives

At the entrance of partner grocery stores, we invite shoppers to add one item to their cart for the families we support.

Find a food drive

Street outreach

In the streets of several Canadian cities, reaching out to the homeless, orphanages and students.

See the full calendar

Areas of help

Four areas of help, always free

  • Food

    Food baskets, hot meals on outreach walks and grocery-store food drives.

  • Clothing

    Coats, boots, wool socks and toques to get through winter.

  • School

    Supplies, lunch boxes and tutoring for orphans.

  • Material or financial

    Practical help when everything else falls short.

La Paix du Cœur Kimia Na Motema

A Christian charity in Montréal since 2014: street outreach, food drives and mutual aid for orphans, widows, people in need and the homeless.
